description: Local Paperclip Kawaii upgrade pipeline. It uses Codex CLI stages to analyze upstream Paperclip changes, repair kawaii UI integration, and review the candidate diff.

stages.name: analyze-upstream
stages.purpose: Compare current paperclip-kawaii against upstream Paperclip before applying repairs. Identify API, route, build, and UI-contract risks. Text output only.

stages.name: repair-kawaii
stages.purpose: Resolve merge conflicts and compatibility gaps after upstream Paperclip updates while preserving the kawaii UI contract.

stages.name: review-repair
stages.purpose: Review the generated candidate diff for regressions, missing tests, broken filters, route wrapper leaks, generated asset selection bugs, and kawaii design violations. Text output only.
